title: To rebuild the Temple you must first find a Red Heifer
summary: Text slide adding a third point: to rebuild the Temple you must first find a Red Heifer to purify yourself and the utensils for Temple services. It follows the earlier lines about religious Jews wanting to rebuild the Temple and rabbis forbidding visits to the Temple Mount because they are unclean.

text.text: Religious Jews want to rebuild Temple.
Rabbis forbid Jews from visiting Temple Mount today,
you must first find a Red Heifer to purify yourself
and the utensils for Temple services.
